full_judgment: 6. Facts of the Special Case No. 5 of 2013 corresponding to Metropolitan Special Case No. 30. of 2012 arising out of Tejgaon Police Station Case No. 15 dated 8-8-2011 corresponding to ACC GR Case No. 84 of 2001, in brief, are that one Harunur-Rashid. Assistant Director (Special inquiry and investigation-1) Anti-Corruption Commission, Head Office, Dhaka, lodged an FIR with Tejgaon Police Station against four accused persons including the accused-petitioner alleging inter alma that an inquiry team was formed on 5-10-2009 and after inquiry a report was submitted. From the report, it reveals that the accused-petitioner as Prime Minister of the country during the tenure of 2001 to 2007, formed 'Shahid Ziaur Rahman Charitable Trust' and the Trust was registered vide deed No.IV-33 dated 26-10-2004 with Gulshan Sub-registry Office. The accused- petitioner is the first trustee and her two sons are members of the said trust. The accused-petitioner as first managing trustee opened an account on 9-1-2005 in the Sonali Bank, Prime Minister's Office Branch. Money was deposited in the account from illegal sources. On 16-1-2005 Taka 26,00,000 through pay order No. 039440; Taka 26,00,000 through pay order No.039438; Taka 31,00,000 through pay order No. 039446; Taka 26,00,000 through pay order No.039439; Taka 26,00,000 through pay order No. 039437; in total Taka 1,35,00,000 was deposited in the said account. Those cheques were issued in the name of Metro Makers and Developers Ltd. The Managing Director of Metro Makers and Developers Ltd. informed that he never paid or gifted any amount to Ziaur Rahman Charitable Trust. He further informed that Monirul Islam Khan, the then Assistant Private Secretary of the Mayor of Dhaka City Corporation managed to deposit the said amount using the name of Metro Makers and Developers Ltd. He also informed that Haris Chowdhury, the then Political Secretary of Prime Minister was given the amount him to deposit the same in the account of said Trust. On 18-1-2005 Taka 27,00,000 was deposited in the account, another amount of Taka 6,18,89,529 was deposited from various accounts of BNP to the said account of Trust. Several notices were issued upon the accused petitioner to make statement regarding the matter on 15-2-2010, 16-3-2010, 28-3-2010 and 20-4-2010 but she did not make any statement. A piece of land measuring 42 kathas was purchased in consideration of Taka 6,52,07,000 paying excess amount of Taka 1,24,93,000 to the owner of land Suria Khan. But mutation khatian was not opened in the name of Trust till date and no rents or taxes paid relating to the land. Thus the accused-petitioner in collusion with other accused persons committed the offence under the aforesaid sections.
